history.message: Document how to run the server (closes #1)
history.author: Mira Chen

files..github/workflows/test.yml:
name: test
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: npm test
files.README.md:
# hello-server
Practice repository for the Smithers tutorial.
Run `npm start` to serve on port 3000.
Run `npm test` to run the tests.
files.src/hello.test.ts:
import { test } from "node:test"
import assert from "node:assert/strict"
import { greet } from "./hello.ts"

test("greets by name", () => assert.equal(greet("Ada"), "Hello, Ada!"))
